# Read and import files
airports <- read.csv("airports.csv", header = TRUE)
carriers <- read.csv("carriers.csv", header = TRUE)
planes <- read.csv("plane-data.csv",stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE)

# Import flight data from 2004 to 2006
df_2004 <- read.csv("2004.csv", header = TRUE)
df_2005 <- read.csv("2005.csv", header = TRUE)
df_2006 <- read.csv("2006.csv", header = TRUE)

# Combine the flight data into one data frame
df_all <- df_2004 %>% rbind(df_2005) %>% rbind(df_2006)
df_all <- na.omit(df_all)

Data Pre-processing

# Limit the time to 0000 to 2400
trim2 <- function(x,min_t, max_t){
 within(df_all, {
  ArrTime[ArrTime < min_t] <- NA
  ArrTime[ArrTime > max_t] <- NA
  DepTime[DepTime < min_t] <- NA
  DepTime[DepTime > max_t] <- NA
})
}

df<- trim2(df_all, min_t=0000, max_t=2400)

# Create date column by pasting the Year, Month, Day
df$Date <- paste(df$Year, df$Month, df$Day)

# Change the format of Date to year-month-day dtetime format
df$Date <- ymd(df$Date)

# Change the format of departure time to hour:time
df$DepTime <- sprintf("%04d", df$DepTime)
df$DepTime <- format(strptime(df$DepTime, format="%H%M"),format = "%H:%M")

# Change the format of arrival time to hour:time
df$ArrTime <- sprintf("%04d", df$ArrTime)
df$ArrTime<- format(strptime(df$ArrTime, format="%H%M"),format = "%H:%M")

# Create time intervals by categorizing departure and arrival time

categories <- c("Dawn", "Morning", "Afternoon", "Evening", "Night", "Midnight")
df$dep_tf <- cut(as.numeric(substr(df$DepTime, 1, 2)),
                 breaks = c(0, 5, 11, 17,19, 22, 24),
                 labels = categories)

df$arr_tf <- cut(as.numeric(substr(df$ArrTime, 1, 2)),
                 breaks = c(0, 5, 11, 17,19, 22, 24),
                 labels = categories)

Data wrangling for Q1

# Create subset from the original flight data frame
sub_all <- df[,c(1:8,15:16,22,24,31)]

# Rename the columns
names(sub_all) <- c("Year","Month","Day","Week","DepTime","ExpDepTime","ArrTime","ExpArrTime","ArrDelay","DepDelay","Cancelled","Diverted","time_cat")

# Remove the NA's
sub_all <- na.omit(sub_all)

The best time of the year to travel

# Q1 for month
q1_mth <- sub_all %>%
filter(Cancelled == 0 & Diverted == 0 & DepDelay > 15) %>% group_by(Month) %>% summarize(avg_delay = mean(DepDelay, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% arrange(avg_delay)
print(head(q1_mth))
## # A tibble: 6 × 2
##   Month avg_delay
##   <int>     <dbl>
## 1     4      51.4
## 2     2      52.3
## 3    11      53.6
## 4    10      53.6
## 5     3      53.9
## 6     9      54.0
# Plot a bar chart showing the average delay by month
ggplot(q1_mth, aes(x = Month, y = avg_delay)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "blue") +
  ggtitle("Average Departure Delay by Month") +
  xlab("Month") +
  ylab("Average Departure Delay (minutes)") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(avg_delay, 2)), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"))

Data wrangling for Q2

# Create subset from the original data
pl_sub <- df[,c(11,15:16,22,24)]

# Join the data with planes and filter out records without cancelled and diverted with departure delay more than 15 minutes
df_pl <- pl_sub %>% 
  rename_all(tolower) %>%
  inner_join(planes, by = "tailnum", suffix = c(".pl_sub", ".planes")) %>% filter(cancelled == 0 & diverted == 0 & depdelay > 15) %>% group_by(model)

# Dealing with dates
# Replace the 'None' in issue_date to NA and convert it to datetime format
df_pl$issue_date <- as.Date(ifelse(df_pl$issue_date == 'None', NA, df_pl$issue_date), format = '%m/%d/%Y')

# Remove the NAs in the dataframe and create 'pl_age' column as the age of planes
df_pl <- na.omit(df_pl)
df_pl$pl_age <- year(Sys.Date()) - year(df_pl$issue_date)

Does the plane age affect the average departure delays?

# Q2
q2<- df_pl %>% group_by(pl_age,model) %>%
  summarize(average_delay = mean(depdelay, na.rm = TRUE))%>% arrange(pl_age)
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'pl_age'. You can override using the
## `.groups` argument.
print(q2)

Data wrangling for Q3

# Create a subset from the original dataframe
df_fl <- df[,c(1,9,17:18)]
ap_q3 <- airports[,c(1:3)]

#Join the data with airports file to get the cities and states according to the iata of airports
q3 <- df_fl %>% 
 inner_join(ap_q3, by = c("Dest" = "iata"), suffix = c(".df_fl", ".airports"))%>%
 inner_join(ap_q3, by = c("Origin" = "iata"), suffix = c(".df_fl", ".airports"))
 
# Rename the columns 
names(q3) <- c("Years", "UniqueCarrier","Origin","Destination","dest_airport","dest_city","org_airport","org_city")

The travel pattern over the years

# Group by the data and create the Frequency column to show the number of flights at each city
q3a <- q3 %>% group_by(org_city,dest_city,Years) %>% summarize(Frequency = n())%>% arrange(desc(Frequency))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'org_city', 'dest_city'. You can override
## using the `.groups` argument.
# Sum up the frequency of flights in each city
q3b <- q3a %>%
  group_by(org_city, dest_city, Years) %>%
  summarize(Frequency = sum(Frequency))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'org_city', 'dest_city'. You can override
## using the `.groups` argument.
# Create a pivot table for the data
q3_pivot <- q3b %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Years, values_from = Frequency, values_fill = 0)

# Arrange the data in descending and choose the top 30 records with the most frequent flights for each year
q3_pivot <- q3_pivot %>% group_by(org_city,dest_city)%>% arrange(desc(`2004`)) %>% head(n=30)

#Create a column to show the Origin-Destination city pair
q3_pivot$city_pair <- paste(q3_pivot$org_city,"-",q3_pivot$dest_city)

q3c <- q3_pivot %>% select(city_pair,`2004`,`2005`,`2006`)
## Adding missing grouping variables: `org_city`, `dest_city`
# Create a grouped bar chart to visualize the results
q3_grouped <- q3c %>%
  gather(year, frequency, `2004`:`2006`) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = city_pair, y = frequency, fill = year)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  xlab("Origin-Destination City Pairs") +
  ylab("Frequency of Flights") +
  ggtitle("Flight Pattern Change over Years") +
  theme(legend.position = "top",axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"))

print(q3_grouped)

# Filter the data with zero cancelled and diverted flights

# Create a column to show that whether the flight is delayed
q4a <- fil_q4a %>%
 mutate(fil_q4a,count_depdelay = ifelse(DepDelay > 15,1,0)) %>% 
 mutate(fil_q4a,count_arrdelay = ifelse(ArrDelay > 15,1,0)) %>%
 summarize(Date = Date, DepTime =DepTime, ArrTime = ArrTime, TailNum=TailNum,Org_airport = Org_airport, Dest_airport = Dest_airport, count_depdelay = count_depdelay, count_arrdelay = count_arrdelay)

Cascading delays detection

# Filter those flights with delays and sum up the counts for departure delays at the origin airports and the counts for arrival delays at the destination airports at the specific Date accroding to the TailNum 
q4b <- q4a %>% filter((count_depdelay ==1)&(count_arrdelay==1))%>% group_by(Org_airport, Dest_airport,TailNum, Date)%>% summarize(count_depdelay = sum(count_depdelay), count_arrdelay = sum(count_arrdelay))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'Org_airport', 'Dest_airport', 'TailNum'.
## You can override using the `.groups` argument.
# Arrange the count_depdelay in descending order and select the top 500 records
q4c <- q4b %>% arrange(desc(count_depdelay)) %>% head(n=500)

# Create joy-plot to compare the distribution of the result
q4d <- rbind(
  data.frame(count = q4c$count_depdelay, type = "Departure Delay"),
  data.frame(count = q4c$count_arrdelay, type = "Arrival Delay")
)


# Create the side-by-side joy plot
library(ggjoy)
## Loading required package: ggridges

ggplot(q4d, aes(x = count, y = type, fill = type)) +

  labs(x = "Delay Count", y = "Frequency") +
  ggtitle("Joy Plot of Departure and Arrival Delays Frequency")+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"))

Environment setting for Q5

#Q5
library(mlr3)
library(mlr3learners)
library(mlr3pipelines)
library(mlr3tuning)
## Loading required package: paradox
# Create time frame categories for scheduled arrival and departure time
df$crsarr_tf <- cut(as.numeric(substr(df$CRSArrTime, 1, 2)),
                 breaks = c(0, 5, 11, 17,19, 22, 24),
                 labels = categories)

df$crsdep_tf <- cut(as.numeric(substr(df$CRSDepTime, 1, 2)),
                 breaks = c(0, 5, 11, 17,19, 22, 24),
                 labels = categories)

# Create dummy variable for arrival delay
q5<- df %>% mutate(df,delayed = ifelse(ArrDelay > 15,1,0))

# Subset the dataframe to extract variables for data training and testing
q5a <- q5[,c(9,11,13,19,31:35)]
q5a <- na.omit(q5a)

# Convert categorical variables to factor 
q5a$delayed <- factor(q5a$delayed)
q5a$arr_tf <- factor(q5a$arr_tf)
q5a$dep_tf <- factor(q5a$dep_tf)
q5a$UniqueCarrier <- factor(q5a$UniqueCarrier)
q5a$crsarr_tf <- factor(q5a$crsarr_tf)
q5a$crsdep_tf <- factor(q5a$crsdep_tf)

# Select a sample size of 150000 for model building
Delayed <- sample_n(q5a, 150000)

# Split up the train set and test set of the data
n <- nrow(Delayed)
train_set <- sample(n, round(0.4*n))
test_set <- setdiff(1:n, train_set)

# Set up the task
task <- TaskClassif$new('Delayed', backend=Delayed, target = 'delayed')
task$select(c('arr_tf','dep_tf','CRSElapsedTime','Distance','UniqueCarrier','crsarr_tf','crsdep_tf'))

# Set up the measurement
measure <- msr('classif.ce')

# Prepare pipelines
fencoder  <- po("encode", method = "treatment",
  affect_columns = selector_type("factor"))
ord_to_int <- po("colapply", applicator = as.integer,
  affect_columns = selector_type("ordered"))

# Prepare tuner
tuner <- tnr('grid_search')
terminator <- trm('evals', n_evals = 20)

Logistic Regression

learner_lr <- lrn("classif.log_reg")
gc_lr <- po('imputemean') %>>% po(learner_lr)
glrn_lr <- GraphLearner$new(gc_lr)

glrn_lr$train(task, row_ids = train_set)
## Warning: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred
## This happened PipeOp classif.log_reg's $train()
glrn_lr$predict(task, row_ids = test_set)$score()
## classif.ce 
##  0.1562444

Gradient Boosting

# Need to install.packages("xgboost")
learner_gb <- lrn("classif.xgboost")
gc_gb <- po('imputemean') %>>%
  fencoder %>>% ord_to_int %>>%
  po(learner_gb)
glrn_gb <- GraphLearner$new(gc_gb)

glrn_gb$train(task, row_ids = train_set)
glrn_gb$predict(task, row_ids = test_set)$score()
## classif.ce 
##  0.1682667

Penalized Logistic Regression

learner_plr <- lrn('classif.glmnet')
gc_plr <- po('scale') %>>% 
  fencoder %>>% ord_to_int %>>%
  po('imputemean') %>>%
  po(learner_plr)
glrn_plr <- GraphLearner$new(gc_plr)
tune_lambda <- ParamSet$new (list(
  ParamDbl$new('classif.glmnet.lambda', lower = 0.001, upper = 2)
))

at_plr <- AutoTuner$new(
  learner = glrn_plr,
  resampling = rsmp('cv', folds = 3),
  measure = measure,
  search_space = tune_lambda,
  terminator = terminator,
  tuner = tuner
)

at_plr$train(task, row_ids = train_set)

Classification Tree

learner_tree <- lrn("classif.rpart")

gc_tree <- po('imputemean') %>>%
  po(learner_tree)
glrn_tree <- GraphLearner$new(gc_tree)

glrn_tree$train(task, row_ids = train_set)
glrn_tree$predict(task, row_ids = test_set)$score()
## classif.ce 
##  0.1722889

Random Forests

learner_rf <- lrn('classif.ranger')
learner_rf$param_set$values <- list(min.node.size = 4)
gc_rf <- po('scale') %>>% 
  po('imputemean') %>>%
  po(learner_rf)
glrn_rf <- GraphLearner$new(gc_rf)
tune_ntrees <- ParamSet$new(list(
  ParamInt$new('classif.ranger.num.trees', lower = 50, upper = 600)
))

at_rf <- AutoTuner$new(
  learner = glrn_rf,
  resampling = rsmp('cv', folds = 3),
  measure = measure,
  search_space = tune_ntrees,
  terminator = terminator,
  tuner = tuner
)


at_rf$train(task, row_ids = train_set)

# Need to install.packages("e1071")

gc_svm <- po('imputemean') %>>%
  fencoder %>>% ord_to_int %>>%
  po(learner_svm)
glrn_svm <- GraphLearner$new(gc_svm)

glrn_svm$train(task, row_ids = train_set)
glrn_svm$predict(task, row_ids = test_set)$score()

Benchmarking

#list of learners

  glrn_lr,
  glrn_gb,
  at_plr,
  glrn_tree,
  at_rf,
  glrn_svm
)
#set the benchmark design and run the comparisons

learners = lrn_list)

bmr <- benchmark(bm_design,store_models = TRUE)
